tool_schemas.name: search_repositories
tool_schemas.description: Searches mirrored repositories using a full-text query over name/description/owner and optional filters (visibility, owner_login, fork, and local lifecycle status), returning a sorted list of repository records. Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums/ranges or unknown fields, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to private/internal repositories, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Full-text query to search repositories by name/description/owner.

is_fork.description: Filter by whether the repository is a fork.

status.description: Filter by local repository lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of repositories to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: search_code
tool_schemas.description: Searches for code matches across mirrored repositories and returns a paged list of matches with repository and file path context (not full file contents). Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; use the cursor from the response to retrieve the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs or invalid paging parameters, NOT_FOUND if a specified repository_id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the targeted repository/owner scope, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Search query for code (keywords and optional qualifiers).

repository_id.description: Restrict search to a specific mirrored repository id.

owner_login.description: Restrict search to repositories owned by this login.

repository_name.description: Restrict search to repositories with this name (used with owner_login to target one repo).

path_prefix.description: Restrict results to files whose path starts with this prefix.

branch_name.description: Restrict results to a specific branch name.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: search_users
tool_schemas.description: Searches mirrored GitHub users by login/name keywords and returns a paged list of user records that match the query. Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; pass the cursor from the response to fetch subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid paging parameters or unknown fields, FORBIDDEN if the search scope is not permitted, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Search query for GitHub users (login/name keywords).

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_issue
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single mirrored issue and returns the issue record, addressed either by issue_id or by (repository_id, issue_number). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if you provide neither identifier form, provide both forms inconsistently, or pass malformed IDs/invalid numbers. Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue (or repository when using repository_id + issue_number) does not exist or is not visible to you, and FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the repository.

repository_id.description: Mirrored repository id containing the issue.

issue_id.description: Mirrored issue id (alternative to repository_id + issue_number).

tool_schemas.name: add_issue_comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment on an issue (identified by issue_id or by repository_id + issue_number) and returns the created comment record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if body is empty/invalid, if identifiers are missing or inconsistent, or if IDs are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue cannot be resolved, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to comment in the repository or the issue is locked, and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

repository_id.description: Mirrored repository id containing the issue.

issue_id.description: Mirrored issue id (alternative to repository_id + issue_number).

body.description: Markdown text for the new comment.

tool_schemas.name: search_issues
tool_schemas.description: Searches mirrored issues using a full-text query over title/body with optional qualifiers and filters (repo/owner, state, creator, assignee, label, and local lifecycle status) and returns a sorted, paged list of issue records. Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums/ranges or malformed repository_id, FORBIDDEN if repository scope is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Full-text query to search issues by title/body and optional qualifiers.

repository_id.description: Restrict search to a specific mirrored repository id.

owner_login.description: Restrict search to repositories owned by this login.

repository_name.description: Restrict search to a repository name (used with owner_login).

label.description: Filter by a single label name.

status.description: Filter by local issue lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_issue
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new issue in the specified mirrored repository and returns the created issue record with its assigned number and metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id/title are missing or malformed, or if labels/assignees are not valid strings. Raises NOT_FOUND if repository_id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to create issues in the repository, and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

repository_id.description: Mirrored repository id to create the issue in.

body.description: Markdown body content for the new issue.

labels.description: List of label names to apply to the issue.

assignees.description: List of GitHub logins to assign to the issue.

tool_schemas.name: list_issues
tool_schemas.description: Lists issues for a mirrored repository with optional filters (state, creator, assignee, label) and sorting, returning a paged list of issue records. Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; use the cursor from the response to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed repository_id or invalid filter/sort parameters, NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the repository, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

repository_id.description: Mirrored repository id to list issues for.

assignee.description: Filter issues by an assignee login.

label.description: Filter issues by a single label name.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: update_issue
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing issue (title, body, state, labels, assignees, and locked) and returns the updated issue record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed issue_id, invalid enum values, or invalid field types; label and assignee updates replace existing values when provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if issue_id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to edit the issue or change lock state, and CONFLICT if the requested state/lock transition is not allowed in the issue’s current status.

issue_id.description: Internal issue id (from gh_issues.id) to update.

assignees.description: Set issue assignees by login (replaces existing assignees).

locked.description: Lock or unlock the issue conversation.

tool_schemas.name: get_issue_comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments for the specified issue_id and returns a paged list of comment records in that issue. Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; provide the cursor to retrieve subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed issue_id or invalid paging parameters, NOT_FOUND if the issue does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the repository containing the issue, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

issue_id.description: Internal issue id (from gh_issues.id) whose comments to fetch.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_repository
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the mirrored repository record for the given repository_id and returns its details, optionally embedding README data and/or a mirrored file-structure snapshot for the specified branch (or the repository’s default branch when branch is omitted). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id is not in the expected format or if branch/include flags are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository_id does not exist or the requested branch/README/file-structure data is not available for that repository, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view the repository.

repository_id.description: Internal repository id (from gh_repositories.id) to retrieve.

include_readme.description: Whether to include README content/metadata if available.

include_file_structure.description: Whether to include mirrored repository file structure information.

branch.description: Branch name to use when reading README/file structure (defaults to repository default branch).

tool_schemas.name: get_commit
tool_schemas.description: Returns the mirrored commit details for sha within the given repository_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id is malformed or sha is not a 7–40 character hex-like SHA string. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or commit cannot be found in the mirrored data for that repository, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read it.

repository_id.description: Internal repository id (from gh_repositories.id) that contains the commit.

sha.description: Commit SHA to retrieve (full SHA preferred).

tool_schemas.name: list_commits
tool_schemas.description: Lists mirrored commits for repository_id on the specified branch, returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more results are available (pass cursor to fetch the next page); results can be filtered by author_login and since/until and sorted by sort/order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id/branch are invalid, limit is out of range, sort/order are unsupported, cursor is malformed, or since is after until. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or branch does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read commit history.

repository_id.description: Internal repository id (from gh_repositories.id) to list commits for.

branch.description: Branch name whose commit history to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of commits to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

since.description: Return commits authored/committed at or after this time (ISO 8601).

until.description: Return commits authored/committed at or before this time (ISO 8601).

tool_schemas.name: list_branches
tool_schemas.description: Lists branches for repository_id, returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when additional branches are available; you can filter by search and sort by sort/order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id is malformed, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or sort/order are unsupported. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to list its branches.

repository_id.description: Internal repository id (from gh_repositories.id) to list branches for.

limit.description: Maximum number of branches to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

search.description: Filter branches by name substring/prefix match.

tool_schemas.name: create_or_update_file
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new file or updates an existing file at path on branch in the specified repository_id, creating a commit with message and returning the updated file metadata and commit reference; when updating, sha must be the current full 40-character blob SHA to enforce optimistic concurrency. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including non-base64 content_base64 or a non-40-char sha) and CONFLICT if sha is missing for an update or does not match the current file SHA. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository, branch, or target path context does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to write to the repository/branch.

repository_id.description: Internal repository id (from gh_repositories.id) where the file will be created/updated.

branch.description: Branch name to write the file to.

path.description: Repository-relative file path to create or update.

content_base64.description: New file content encoded as base64.

message.description: Commit message for the file create/update.

sha.description: Current full 40-character blob SHA of the existing file (required when updating an existing file).

tool_schemas.name: create_repository
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new repository and returns the mirrored repository record, applying the requested visibility and optional description/default_branch/readme_path initialization, and setting the local lifecycle status if provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is invalid/empty, visibility/status are not one of the allowed values, or other fields fail validation. Raises CONFLICT if a repository with the same name already exists in the target account context, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to create repositories with the requested visibility.

default_branch.description: Default branch name (if supported at creation time; otherwise stored after creation).

readme_path.description: Path to README file to initialize (e.g., README.md).

status.description: Local lifecycle status to set for the mirrored repository record.

tool_schemas.name: get_file_contents
tool_schemas.description: Returns the contents and metadata for the file at path from the specified ref (or the repository’s default branch when ref is omitted). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id or path are invalid or ref is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository, ref, or file does not exist (or if the path resolves to a non-file), and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the repository.

repository_id.description: ID of the mirrored GitHub repository (gh_repositories.id).

ref.description: Git ref to read from (branch name, tag name, or commit SHA); defaults to the repository's default branch if omitted.

tool_schemas.name: fork_repository
tool_schemas.description: Forks the specified repository into the authenticated user account or the provided organization and returns the newly created fork’s mirrored repository record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id is malformed or if organization/name/default_branch_only are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the source repository does not exist, CONFLICT if a repository with the target fork name already exists in the destination account/org, and FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to fork into the destination or to access the source repository.

repository_id.description: ID of the mirrored GitHub repository to fork (gh_repositories.id).

organization.description: Organization login to fork into; if omitted, forks into the authenticated user's account.

name.description: Name for the new fork; if omitted, uses the source repository name.

default_branch_only.description: If true, fork only the default branch.

tool_schemas.name: create_branch
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new branch named branch_name in repository_id from from_ref (or from the repository’s default branch when from_ref is omitted) and returns the created branch/ref metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id or branch_name are invalid or from_ref is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or source ref cannot be resolved, CONFLICT if branch_name already exists, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to create branches in the repository.

repository_id.description: ID of the mirrored GitHub repository to create the branch in (gh_repositories.id).

branch_name.description: Name of the new branch to create.

from_ref.description: Source ref to branch from (branch name, tag name, or commit SHA); defaults to the repository's default branch if omitted.

tool_schemas.name: list_tags
tool_schemas.description: Lists git tags for repository_id, returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more tags are available; results can be sorted by sort/order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id is malformed, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or sort/order are unsupported. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to list tags for the repository.

repository_id.description: ID of the mirrored GitHub repository to list tags for (gh_repositories.id).

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_tag
tool_schemas.description: Returns details for the named tag in the specified mirrored repository, resolving the tag name as "refs/tags/{tag_name}" and returning the stored tag metadata (including its target object) when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id or tag_name is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist or the tag is not present in that repository, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the repository.

repository_id.description: ID of the mirrored GitHub repository (gh_repositories.id).

tag_name.description: Tag name to fetch (without the refs/tags/ prefix).

tool_schemas.name: push_files
tool_schemas.description: Creates a single new commit on the specified branch applying the provided file operations (create/update/delete) and returns the resulting commit/ref update information. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid repository_id, empty files, unsupported operation/encoding, or missing content for create/update; NOT_FOUND if the repository or target branch does not exist; CONFLICT if an operation is impossible (e.g., creating an existing path, deleting a missing path) or if expected_blob_sha is provided and does not match the current blob at that path; and FORBIDDEN if you lack write access to the repository.

repository_id.description: ID of the mirrored GitHub repository to push to (gh_repositories.id).

branch_name.description: Target branch name to commit to.

files.description: List of file operations to include in the commit.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the file to create/update/delete.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded file content for create/update; omit when deleting.

expected_blob_sha.description: Expected current blob SHA for concurrency control; if provided and mismatched, the update should fail.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def push_files(repository_id, branch_name, commit_message, files, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, base64, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0154000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0154000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "push_files"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _parse_iso(s):
        try:
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00")).astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _log_name():
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(_DB, "gh_request_logs.json")):
            return "gh_request_logs.json"
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(_DB, "gh_request_log.json")):
            return "gh_request_log.json"
        return "gh_request_logs.json"

    def _ensure_list(x):
        return x if isinstance(x, list) else []

    def _log_row(status, error_code=None):
        name = _log_name()
        logs = _ensure_list(_load(name))
        row = {
            "id": "ghrl_" + hashlib.sha1(f"{endpoint}|{time.time_ns()}".encode()).hexdigest()[:20],
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "timestamp": _now(),
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "status": status,
        }
        if error_code:
            row["error_code"] = error_code
        logs.append(row)
        _save(name, logs)

    def _enforce_rate_limit():
        name = _log_name()
        logs = _ensure_list(_load(name))
        cutoff = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc) - datetime.timedelta(seconds=60)
        cnt = 0
        for r in logs[-5000:]:
            if not isinstance(r, dict):
                continue
            ts = r.get("timestamp") or r.get("ts")
            if isinstance(ts, str):
                dt = _parse_iso(ts)
                if dt and dt >= cutoff:
                    cnt += 1
        if cnt >= 120:
            return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limit exceeded. Please retry later.")
        return None

    rl = _enforce_rate_limit()
    if rl:
        _log_row("error", rl["error"]["code"])
        return rl

    if not isinstance(repository_id, str) or not re.match(r"^ghr_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", repository_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Malformed repository_id.", field="repository_id")
        _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(branch_name, str) or branch_name.strip() == "":
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "branch_name must be a non-empty string.", field="branch_name")
        _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(commit_message, str) or commit_message.strip() == "":
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "commit_message must be a non-empty string.", field="commit_message")
        _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
        return e
    if not isinstance(files, list) or len(files) < 1:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "files must be a non-empty array.", field="files")
        _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
        return e

    repos = _ensure_list(_load("gh_repositories.json"))
    repo = None
    for r in repos:
        if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == repository_id and r.get("status") == "active":
            repo = r
            break
    if repo is None:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Repository not found.", repository_id=repository_id)
        _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
        return e

    refs = _ensure_list(_load("gh_git_refs.json"))
    branch_ref = None
    for ref in refs:
        if isinstance(ref, dict) and ref.get("repository_id") == repository_id and ref.get("ref_type") == "branch" and ref.get("name") == branch_name and ref.get("status") == "active":
            branch_ref = ref
            break
    if branch_ref is None:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Target branch not found.", repository_id=repository_id, branch_name=branch_name)
        _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
        return e

    gh_files = _ensure_list(_load("gh_files.json"))
    now = _now()

    def _sha1_hex(s):
        return hashlib.sha1(s.encode()).hexdigest()

    def _make_blob_sha(path, content_bytes):
        # 40-hex deterministic-ish blob sha
        return _sha1_hex(f"blob|{repository_id}|{path}|{len(content_bytes)}|{hashlib.sha1(content_bytes).hexdigest()}")[:40]

    updated_files = []
    changed_paths = set()

    # Build an index for branch-scoped upserts: unique(repository_id, branch_name, path)
    index = {}
    for i, row in enumerate(gh_files):
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        if row.get("repository_id") == repository_id and row.get("branch_name") == branch_name:
            p = row.get("path")
            if isinstance(p, str):
                index[p] = i

    for op in files:
        if not isinstance(op, dict):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Each item in files must be an object.", field="files")
            _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
            return e

        path = op.get("path")
        operation = op.get("operation")
        encoding = op.get("encoding")
        content_base64 = op.get("content_base64")
        expected_blob_sha = op.get("expected_blob_sha")

        if not isinstance(path, str) or path.strip() == "":
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "File path must be a non-empty string.", field="path")
            _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
            return e
        if operation not in ("create", "update", "delete"):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid operation.", field="operation")
            _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
            return e

        if encoding is None:
            encoding = "base64" if content_base64 is not None else None
        if encoding is not None and encoding not in ("base64", "utf-8", "none"):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid encoding.", field="encoding")
            _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
            return e

        if expected_blob_sha is not None:
            if not isinstance(expected_blob_sha, str) or not re.match(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$", expected_blob_sha):
                e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "expected_blob_sha must be a 40-hex string when provided.", field="expected_blob_sha")
                _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
                return e
            expected_blob_sha = expected_blob_sha.lower()

        exists_idx = index.get(path)
        existing = gh_files[exists_idx] if exists_idx is not None else None

        if operation in ("create", "update"):
            if content_base64 is None or not isinstance(content_base64, str) or content_base64 == "":
                e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "content_base64 is required for create/update.", field="content_base64")
                _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
                return e

            # Decode depending on encoding to compute size/blob sha; store cached as base64 if provided.
            try:
                if encoding == "base64":
                    content_bytes = base64.b64decode(content_base64.encode("utf-8"), validate=False)
                    store_b64 = content_base64
                    store_encoding = "base64"
                elif encoding == "utf-8":
                    content_bytes = content_base64.encode("utf-8")
                    store_b64 = base64.b64encode(content_bytes).decode("utf-8")
                    store_encoding = "utf-8"
                else:  # none
                    content_bytes = content_base64.encode("utf-8")
                    store_b64 = content_base64
                    store_encoding = "none"
            except Exception:
                e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid content for given encoding.", field="content_base64")
                _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
                return e

            new_blob_sha = _make_blob_sha(path, content_bytes)
            size_bytes = len(content_bytes)

            if operation == "create":
                if existing is not None and existing.get("status") == "present":
                    e = _err("CONFLICT", "File already exists.", path=path)
                    _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
                    return e
                # If exists but deleted, allow re-create but enforce optimistic check if provided.
                if existing is not None and expected_blob_sha is not None and (existing.get("blob_sha") or "").lower() != expected_blob_sha:
                    e = _err("CONFLICT", "expected_blob_sha does not match current blob_sha.", path=path)
                    _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
                    return e

                new_row = {
                    "id": "ghf_" + hashlib.sha1(f"{repository_id}|{branch_name}|{path}|{time.time_ns()}".encode()).hexdigest()[:22],
                    "repository_id": repository_id,
                    "path": path,
                    "branch_name": branch_name,
                    "blob_sha": new_blob_sha,
                    "size_bytes": size_bytes,
                    "encoding": store_encoding,
                    "content_base64": store_b64,
                    "last_commit_sha": None,  # set after commit created
                    "status": "present",
                    "created_at": now,
                    "updated_at": now,
                }
                if existing is None:
                    gh_files.append(new_row)
                    index[path] = len(gh_files) - 1
                    updated_files.append(new_row)
                else:
                    # overwrite deleted row without invalid lifecycle transition by treating it as new row
                    gh_files.append(new_row)
                    index[path] = len(gh_files) - 1
                    updated_files.append(new_row)

            else:  # update
                if existing is None or existing.get("status") != "present":
                    e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Cannot update a file that does not exist.", path=path)
                    _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
                    return e
                if expected_blob_sha is not None and (existing.get("blob_sha") or "").lower() != expected_blob_sha:
                    e = _err("CONFLICT", "expected_blob_sha does not match current blob_sha.", path=path)
                    _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
                    return e
                existing["blob_sha"] = new_blob_sha
                existing["size_bytes"] = size_bytes
                existing["encoding"] = store_encoding
                existing["content_base64"] = store_b64
                existing["updated_at"] = now
                existing["status"] = "present"
                updated_files.append(existing)

            changed_paths.add(path)

        else:  # delete
            if existing is None or existing.get("status") != "present":
                e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Cannot delete a file that does not exist.", path=path)
                _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
                return e
            if expected_blob_sha is not None and (existing.get("blob_sha") or "").lower() != expected_blob_sha:
                e = _err("CONFLICT", "expected_blob_sha does not match current blob_sha.", path=path)
                _log_row("error", e["error"]["code"])
                return e
            existing["status"] = "deleted"
            existing["updated_at"] = now
            existing["content_base64"] = None
            updated_files.append(existing)
            changed_paths.add(path)

    # Create a resulting commit sha (40 hex)
    commit_sha = hashlib.sha1(f"commit|{repository_id}|{branch_name}|{commit_message}|{sorted(changed_paths)}|{time.time_ns()}".encode()).hexdigest()[:40]
    commit_sha = commit_sha.lower()

    commits = _ensure_list(_load("gh_commits.json"))
    # upsert commit by (repository_id, sha)
    existing_commit = None
    for c in commits:
        if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("repository_id") == repository_id and (c.get("sha") or "").lower() == commit_sha:
            existing_commit = c
            break

    if existing_commit is None:
        commit_row = {
            "id": "ghcmt_" + hashlib.sha1(f"{repository_id}|{commit_sha}".encode()).hexdigest()[:22],
            "repository_id": repository_id,
            "sha": commit_sha,
            "author_login": None,
            "author_name": None,
            "author_email": None,
            "authored_at": now,
            "committer_name": None,
            "committer_email": None,
            "committed_at": now,
            "message": commit_message,
            "parent_shas": [branch_ref.get("head_commit_sha")] if branch_ref.get("head_commit_sha") else [],
            "status": "known",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        commits.append(commit_row)
    else:
        # idempotent-ish: refresh updated_at/message if re-pushing same computed sha (unlikely)
        existing_commit["updated_at"] = now
        if existing_commit.get("message") in (None, ""):
            existing_commit["message"] = commit_message

    # Update branch head
    branch_ref["head_commit_sha"] = commit_sha
    branch_ref["updated_at"] = now

    # Set last_commit_sha on touched files
    for p in changed_paths:
        idx = index.get(p)
        if idx is None:
            continue
        row = gh_files[idx]
        if isinstance(row, dict):
            row["last_commit_sha"] = commit_sha
            row["updated_at"] = now

    _save("gh_files.json", gh_files)
    _save("gh_commits.json", commits)
    _save("gh_git_refs.json", refs)

    _log_row("ok")
    return {
        "repository_id": repository_id,
        "branch_name": branch_name,
        "commit": {"sha": commit_sha, "message": commit_message},
        "ref": {"name": branch_name, "full_ref": f"refs/heads/{branch_name}", "head_commit_sha": commit_sha},
        "files_updated": list(changed_paths),
    }

tool_schemas.name: get_pull_request
tool_schemas.description: Returns the mirrored pull request details for the given repository and pull_request_number. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the repository or pull request number does not exist in that repository, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the repository.

repository_id.description: ID of the mirrored GitHub repository containing the PR (gh_repositories.id).

pull_request_number.description: Pull request number within the repository.

tool_schemas.name: update_pull_request
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing pull request (title, body, state open/closed, and/or base branch retargeting when supported) and returns the updated pull request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are invalid or no updatable fields are provided; NOT_FOUND if the repository or pull request does not exist; CONFLICT if the requested state transition is not allowed (e.g., attempting to set a merged state) or the base_branch is invalid for retargeting; and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to modify the pull request.

repository_id.description: ID of the mirrored GitHub repository containing the PR (gh_repositories.id).

pull_request_number.description: Pull request number within the repository.

title.description: New title for the pull request.

body.description: New body/description for the pull request.

state.description: New state for the pull request (merged is not settable via update).

base_branch.description: New base branch name to retarget the pull request.

tool_schemas.name: list_pull_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists pull requests in the specified repository matching the provided filters and sorting, returning up to limit results and a cursor for the next page when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values, sort/order, limit out of range, or malformed cursor; NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist; and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the repository.

repository_id.description: ID of the repository to list pull requests for.

creator_login.description: Filter pull requests by creator GitHub login.

base_branch.description: Filter pull requests by base branch name.

head_branch.description: Filter pull requests by head branch name.

review_status.description: Filter pull requests by review status.

limit.description: Maximum number of pull requests to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: merge_pull_request
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to merge the specified pull request using the requested merge_method and optional commit title/message, returning the updated pull request/merge result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs or merge_method; NOT_FOUND if the pull request does not exist; CONFLICT if the pull request is not in a mergeable state (e.g., already closed/merged, has merge conflicts, or otherwise cannot be merged with the chosen method); and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to merge in the target repository.

pull_request_id.description: ID of the pull request to merge.

commit_title.description: Title to use for the merge commit (if applicable).

commit_message.description: Message to use for the merge commit (if applicable).

merge_method.description: Merge method to use when merging the pull request.

tool_schemas.name: get_pull_request_files
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of files changed in the specified pull request, returning up to limit items and a cursor for the next page when more files are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pull_request_id, limit out of range, or malformed cursor; NOT_FOUND if the pull request does not exist; and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the pull request’s repository.

pull_request_id.description: ID of the pull request to retrieve changed files for.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of files.

tool_schemas.name: get_pull_request_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current status summary for the specified pull request (e.g., state/mergeability indicators as tracked by the mirror). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pull_request_id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the pull request does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the pull request’s repository.

pull_request_id.description: ID of the pull request to retrieve status for.

tool_schemas.name: update_pull_request_branch
tool_schemas.description: Not implemented: this endpoint does not update a pull request branch from its base branch and returns an error instead of a result. Raises NOT_IMPLEMENTED for all calls, plus VALIDATION_ERROR if pull_request_id is missing/invalid.

pull_request_id.description: ID of the pull request whose branch should be updated from the base branch.

tool_schemas.name: get_pull_request_comments
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of comments associated with the specified pull request, returning up to limit comments and a cursor for the next page when more comments are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pull_request_id, limit out of range, or malformed cursor; NOT_FOUND if the pull request does not exist; and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the pull request’s repository.

pull_request_id.description: ID of the pull request to retrieve comments for.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of comments.

tool_schemas.name: create_pull_request
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new pull request in the specified repository from `head_branch` (optionally in `head_repository_full_name` when opening from a fork) into `base_branch`, and returns the created pull request record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs or branch names are invalid, or `head_repository_full_name` is not in `owner/repo` form; raises NOT_FOUND if the repository (or specified head repository) does not exist or either branch cannot be resolved; raises CONFLICT if `base_branch` and `head_branch` are the same or an equivalent open pull request for the same head/base already exists; raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to create pull requests in the target repository.

repository_id.description: ID of the repository to create the pull request in.

title.description: Title of the new pull request.

body.description: Body/description of the new pull request.

base_branch.description: Name of the branch you want the changes pulled into.

head_branch.description: Name of the branch where your changes are implemented.

head_repository_full_name.description: Full name (owner/repo) of the head repository when creating from a fork.

tool_schemas.name: update_repository
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a mirrored repository and returns the updated record. Supports lifecycle transition of repository status between active/archived/deleted as allowed; refuses invalid transitions, attempts to update immutable identifiers, and returns NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist.

repository_id.description: Mirrored repository id to update.

description.description: New repository description (omit to leave unchanged).

default_branch.description: New default branch name (omit to leave unchanged).

status.description: New local lifecycle status. Only allowed transitions are enforced.
